jobs.description: Fetch the latest prices for every holding.
jobs.label: Refresh prices now

jobs.description: Drops the cached closes and splits of one instrument (manual fixes stay) and downloads them again, then rebuilds the valuation history.
jobs.label: Re-download one instrument's prices

jobs.description: Download stock splits for every instrument again.
jobs.label: Re-fetch splits

jobs.description: Fetch the current EUR/USD market rate (or backfill the last forex session's closing rate when the currency market is closed) from Yahoo Finance / Tiingo so today's figures do not rely on the ECB end-of-day reference rate.
jobs.label: Refresh live FX rate now

jobs.description: Fill gaps in the daily EUR rates from the ECB reference rates.
jobs.label: Re-download FX history

jobs.description: Recompute the stored EUR/USD legs of transactions from the FX history.
jobs.label: Recalculate FX legs

params.label: Recompute every row, not only missing ones
params.name: force

jobs.description: Recompute the daily portfolio values (from a date, or all).
jobs.label: Rebuild valuation history

jobs.description: Rebuild the intraday graphs: re-download the minute prices and the EUR/USD minute rates for the last session and week (Yahoo Finance, Tiingo filling gaps), so the EUR line uses the rate of each minute. Use it when the EUR 1D / 1W line has holes or sits on a flat daily rate.
jobs.label: Reload 1D / 1W graphs (prices + EUR/USD)

jobs.description: Delete the stored 1D or 1W samples; they refill during the next session.
jobs.label: Clear intraday samples

jobs.description: Remove cached prices of instruments no longer in the ledger.
jobs.label: Clean up cache

jobs.description: Deletes all prices, FX rates, snapshots and graph samples, then downloads them again. Transactions and settings stay. A backup is taken first.
jobs.label: Reset cached market data

jobs.description: Download the benchmark's price history again.
jobs.label: Refresh benchmark

jobs.description: Fetch the current risk-free rate.
jobs.label: Refresh risk-free rate

jobs.description: Fill holes in the 1 Day / 1 Week graphs where yfinance has no bars, from Tiingo's 5-minute prices. Costs one Tiingo request per held stock/ETF plus one for EUR/USD; refuses if the hourly/daily allowance can't cover it. Your own live points are never replaced.
jobs.label: Fill graph gaps from Tiingo

jobs.description: Ask Tiingo for every holding whose price is behind (skips the ones already current, so it only spends requests where Tiingo can add something).
jobs.label: Re-pull prices from Tiingo

jobs.description: Forget the Tiingo request counters and learned NAV timings (caps stay).
jobs.label: Reset Tiingo budget state

jobs.description: Fetch the twins' prices for the current/last session (previous close and the price now while the market is open), backfill any missing earlier-week bars, and top up the one-year close history the twin-accuracy figures read.
jobs.label: Refresh ETF twin prices now

jobs.description: Force the one-year daily-close backfill to run again for every twin currently held, even one already done or given up on after repeated failures — use this after fixing a twin mapping, or to fill a gap downtime left in the history.
jobs.label: Re-download ETF twin history

jobs.description: Delete every stored ETF-twin price (intraday bars and session closes) and reset its backfill markers; the next refresh fills them in again. Use this to reset a bad twin mapping.
jobs.label: Clear stored twin prices

jobs.description: Write a sealed snapshot of the database.
jobs.label: Back up now

jobs.description: Unseal a snapshot in a temporary folder and run an integrity check.
jobs.label: Verify a backup

jobs.description: SQLite integrity check of the live database.
jobs.label: Run integrity check

uses.detail: When yfinance fails, returns nothing, or serves frozen quotes for a stock or ETF during the session, the latest IEX price is fetched from Tiingo (automatic, after a short grace period).
uses.title: Live price backup

uses.detail: After the close, when yfinance has not yet published a mutual fund's NAV, a few spaced-out probes ask Tiingo whether it has it (automatic, at most 8 a day).
uses.title: Fund NAV check

uses.detail: When yfinance has no intraday EUR/USD bars for the 1 Day / 1 Week graph, one request fetches them from Tiingo (automatic).
uses.title: EUR/USD intraday bars

uses.detail: Fills holes in the 1 Day / 1 Week graphs where yfinance has no bars: one request per held stock/ETF plus one for EUR/USD. Runs by itself when a frozen-feed stall ends, or from Repair > Providers > Fill graph gaps from Tiingo.
uses.title: Graph gap fill

uses.detail: Repair > Providers > Re-pull prices from Tiingo: checks every holding against Tiingo once, skipping those that already have the newest price.
uses.title: Manual price re-pull

fields.help: The figures are called Live only while the market is open, the last price pull is at most this old and the newest stock/ETF price itself was struck on the exchange at most this long ago. Keep it above the ETF/stock price age, or Live flickers between pulls.
fields.label: Live: newest price at most this old

fields.help: When every stock/ETF price stays exactly unchanged (or the provider's own price time is older) for this long while the market is open, the feed counts as stalled: the top bar says Delayed, no 1 Day graph points are stored, and Health & Repair lists the stretch.
fields.label: Frozen price feed: alarm after

fields.help: While currencies trade (Sunday evening to Friday evening, New York time), Health & Repair warns when the live EUR/USD rate is missing, has not been refreshed for this long, or has stayed exactly the same for this long (a frozen feed). The ECB rate is each day's official rate and never warns on its own.
fields.label: Live EUR/USD rate: warn when stale after

fields.help: While a mutual fund's NAV for the session has not posted yet, its ETF twin estimates it, and that estimate replaces the headline portfolio value (and the Holdings rows' twin figures) everywhere on the Overview and Holdings pages. Turn this off to show only the official total, with its last posted NAV, until the real NAV lands — the twin-accuracy figures below still track how the twin has been doing, they are just not blended into the total.
fields.label: Estimate pending mutual-fund NAVs from their ETF twin

fields.help: A mutual fund's estimate (while its NAV is not posted yet) comes from its ETF twin. The Holdings page shows how far the twin was from the real NAV: the last session, and the typical gap and bias over this many recent sessions. Sessions with a dividend or distribution are left out.
fields.label: ETF twin accuracy: look back over

fields.help: EUR/USD trades around the clock on weekdays (Sunday 17:00 to Friday 17:00 New York time) on its own clock, separate from the stock market: it is checked at this pace whenever it trades, day or night.
